about_the_game:
Step into the shoes of Aryn and join her in the epic fight to save her home planet!

Dive into the retroflow and unleash your adrenaline in fast-paced shoot-em-up action. Pilot the R1 scouting ship and face relentless Tars invaders in thrilling, high-intensity battles across the universe.

RESHOOTER is the spiritual successor to "Reshoot," "RESHOOT R," and "Reshoot Proxima 3" (all published exclusively for the Commodore Amiga), and is finally bringing the beloved franchise to PC for the first time.

FEATURES

- Engage in a modern arcade experience designed for both hardcore and beginner players.

- Help Aryn in her quest to save her home world from a ruthless aggressor.

- Experience five beautifully handcrafted stages (three available in early access).

- Utilize physics-based tactics to alter landscapes and block enemy fire.

- Compete in highscore-hunting for endless replayability.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11 / 64bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 770 / AMD Radeon™ RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 12
